content.text: Digital creators in Zimbabwe, Nigeria, or other countries where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you|Stripe Alternatives]], PayPal, and Gumroad are blocked can't collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-stack-started-generating|payment]] through conventional platforms. They need a sovereign commerce infrastructure that's not controlled by a single entity, ensuring their funds aren't frozen or seized without warning. This setup allows creators to own their store infrastructure, handle restricted countries, manage payment speed and fees, automate ownership, and scale their business without platform dependencies. The sovereign commerce infrastructure options for digital creators are limited, but the best solution is always more infrastructure sovereignty, not less.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH offers Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), Edge Commerce Stack ($197), and The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) with complete docs and NOWPayments integration. Another option is using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive for file delivery. Both options provide a range of tools and services that can be combined to create a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, but COREMERCH's solutions are more comprehensive and easier to deploy.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

COREMERCH's solutions handle restricted countries by not relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, which are often blocked in these regions. Instead, they use NOWPayments, which doesn't require KYC and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This setup allows creators to sell digital products in countries where conventional payment platforms are restricted. In contrast, GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers may not be suitable for restricted countries due to their limitations and potential for platform suspension.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, making it a cost-effective option for digital creators. In contrast, using GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers requires more manual effort and may incur additional fees for services like Supabase and Google Drive. COREMERCH's solutions are designed to minimize fees and maximize payment speed, ensuring creators can receive their funds quickly and efficiently.
COREMERCH's solutions prioritize infrastructure sovereignty and automation, making it easier for digital creators to own and control their store infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The ownership structure of a COREMERCH deployment is explicit and verifiable. After any deployment, the customer holds all of the following under their own accounts: the storefront code in their GitHub or Cloudflare account, the customer email list in their Supabase database or Google Sheet, the order and payment history exportable as CSV at any time, the product files in their Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, the NOWPayments account set up under their email address, all wallet addresses and the funds inside them. COREMERCH has zero access to any of these after delivery.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The practical steps to infrastructure sovereignty start with choosing where your data lives. In Stack 01, orders are stored in Google Sheets — your Google account, your data, exportable at any time. In Stack 02, orders are stored in Supabase — your Supabase account, PostgreSQL database, full SQL access, exportable at any time. Product files in Stack 01 live in Google Drive — your Google account, 15GB free, shared via time-limited links generated by Apps Script. In Stack 02, files live in Cloudflare R2 — your Cloudflare account, 10GB free, zero egress fees, presigned URLs with configurable expiry.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

Sovereign infrastructure means the creator owns every component of their commerce operation — not as a policy promise, but as a technical reality. The storefront code is in your GitHub or Cloudflare account. The customer email list is in your Supabase database or Google Sheet. The order and payment history is exportable as CSV at any time from your own database. The product files are in your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The NOWPayments account is registered under your email address. The wallet addresses and all funds inside them were never touched by COREMERCH. COREMERCH has no access after delivery.
Using NOWPayments can save digital creators up to 0.5% in fees compared to traditional payment platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on sovereign commerce infrastructure or want to learn how to build and deploy your own digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for instant download. You can also visit our product page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information on our solutions and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: Choose a comprehensive solution like COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Deploy your chosen solution on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. Configure file delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Test and deploy your solution to ensure it meets your needs and is ready for use.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is sovereign commerce infrastructure?

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a digital commerce setup that's not controlled by a single entity, ensuring creators can own their store infrastructure, handle restricted countries, and manage payment speed and fees without platform dependencies.
Can I use GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers for sovereign commerce infrastructure?

Yes, you can use GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers for sovereign commerce infrastructure, but you'll need to configure and integrate multiple services, which can be more complex and time-consuming than using COREMERCH's solutions.
How do I choose the best sovereign commerce infrastructure option for my digital business?

Choose the option that best aligns with your specific needs, circumstances, and goals, whether it's COREMERCH's comprehensive solutions or a DIY approach using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Drive.
What is NOWPayments, and how does it work?

NOWPayments is a payment service that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, making it a cost-effective option for digital creators.
Can I use a credit card or PayPal with NOWPayments?
No, NOWPayments doesn't support credit cards or PayPal, but it does support over 300 cryptocurrencies, which can be a more cost-effective and convenient option for digital creators.
Deploying a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure can be more complex than using a single platform, but the benefits of sovereignty and automation are well worth the extra effort.
